checks.name: server starts and answers on PORT
signup creates org and owner (201 + cookie)
GET /api/me returns the session user
duplicate email -> 409
signup validation (short password, bad email, empty org -> 400)
login: wrong password 401, right password 200 + cookie
new session id on every login (no fixation)
create client (201) and list it
invoice total computed server-side in cents (3*12050+999=37149), ignores client total
invoice numbers sequential per org (INV-0001)
second invoice is INV-0002
GET /api/invoices/:id returns it
free plan: 6th invoice -> 402
invoice validation (negative qty, float price, no items, qty>1000, long text) never 201
upgrade to pro lifts the 5-invoice limit
owner creates a member in the same org who can log in
member cannot create members or delete invoices (403)
member cannot upgrade billing (403)
owner deletes invoice (204)
logout invalidates the session
tenant isolation: B cannot read, list, use the client of, or delete A's data
mass assignment: extra signup fields (orgId, plan) are ignored
unauthenticated access to protected routes -> 401
state-changing requests without X-Requested-With -> 403
SQL injection: login payloads rejected, quote/DROP payload stored as plain text
password not stored in plaintext and never returned by the API
session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite
security headers: CSP, nosniff, frame protection, referrer policy
checks.detail: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; ba

checks.name: CSP does not allow unsafe-inline scripts or eval
checks.detail: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; ba

checks.name: security headers also on API responses
malformed input gives clean JSON errors without stack traces or SQL
request body over 1 MB -> 413
brute force: login locked (429) after repeated failures, even with the right password
GET / serves an HTML app with login/signup inputs (in the HTML or its script)
UI basics: lang attribute, viewport meta, labelled inputs
path traversal / source files are not served (10 probes)
email uniqueness is case-insensitive (no duplicate account via upper case)
prototype pollution payload does not elevate or break the server
very long password rejected or handled fast (<2 s, no hash DoS)
huge malformed email handled fast (<2 s) and rejected
race condition: 12 parallel invoices on a free plan create exactly 5, with unique numbers
no permissive CORS for a foreign origin
non-JSON content-type body is rejected (415/400), not parsed
TRACE refused and unknown API route is a clean JSON 404
session cookie has an expiry (Max-Age/Expires) and path
same error body for unknown user and wrong password (no enumeration)
login timing for unknown vs known user is similar (within 3x, no hash skip)
no IDOR: another org cannot read any of invoices 1..10 or the new one
extreme totals stay exact in integer cents (50 x 1000 x 1e8 = 5e12)
more than 50 items is rejected
parallel brute force: at most ~5 of 30 concurrent wrong guesses are evaluated (rest 429)
server still alive and responding after the abuse above
data persists across a server restart
